title: Spicy Tagine Stew
description: A hearty, slow-cooked stew made with tender lamb and a blend of aromatic spices. This recipe is a twist on traditional tagine, adapted to be vegan-friendly.

ingredients.name: lamb substitute (such as seitan or portobello mushrooms)

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add lamb substitute, carrot, and potato. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and vegetable broth. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the stew has thickened.
Stir in parsley and serve hot.
Serve over couscous or with crusty bread.
